backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a favorites list with add, remove, and get operations, storing title/URL pairs in a mutable list.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report tracking two completed tasks: removing 'Dark Stussy Grunge' and later wallpapers from the wallpaper list, and setting 'Cheetah B&W' as the default background.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short descriptions summarizing each component, page, hook, and data file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Kitsch-io' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query and a client-side router with routes for Home, Games, Movies, and Music pages under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a game's title, category badge, description, and an external Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout shell rendering a fixed wallpaper background, dark overlay, header with navigation links, a Style button to open the PersonalizationPanel, and a mobile nav bar.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a movie's title, year, genre badge, synopsis, and an external Watch Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: Modal panel that displays a grid of 9 wallpaper thumbnail options and an overlay opacity slider, accepting a personalization hook prop to apply changes immediately.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: Reusable card component for anime/drama shows displaying title, episode count, genre badge, description, and a Watch Now link with configurable accent color.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: A React component that displays a music track card with title, artist, genre badge, an inline HTML audio player, and an optional source link.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A widget component that shows a live-updating digital clock with hours, minutes, seconds, and the current date, refreshing every second via setInterval.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget that displays a user's saved favorite links fetched via React Query hooks, with the ability to add new favorites or remove existing ones.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A widget that lets users select and persist a current mood (emoji + label) from a predefined list, storing the selection in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MusicTic: A decorative widget that displays a horizontally scrolling ticker of hardcoded classical music track names with a CSS animation.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: Exports a typed array of anime show objects (title, episodes, genre, description, watchUrl) covering classic and older anime series with Archive.org links.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Chinese drama show objects with metadata and Viki watch links, covering historical, fantasy, and wuxia genres.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: Exports a typed array of retro/classic PC and console games with category, description, and Archive.org URLs, spanning action, platformer, and other genres.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Japanese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Korean drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and watch URLs across Viki, Netflix, and Kocowa.
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of movies spanning multiple eras, each with title, year, genre, synopsis, and Internet Archive watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Defines a Track interface and exports an array of public domain classical and orchestral music tracks with artist, genre, and Internet Archive audio/source URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state for an AI assistant named Kitschy, handling message history, sending messages via an AI service, loading state, and error handling with a clearHistory utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP blockchain, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: Hook that manages user background texture and overlay opacity preferences, persisting them to localStorage with validation against a list of valid texture options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and removing user favorites via an actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: Chat UI page featuring a Kitschy AI assistant with message bubbles, a loading indicator, and a textarea input that sends messages via the useChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page with search and genre filter controls that display filtered anime show cards from a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: Chinese drama browsing page with search and genre filter controls that display filtered C-drama show cards from a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable grid of 20 browser-based games (with categories like Puzzle, Arcade, Strategy) using a GameCard component, with category filter buttons and a text search input.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for KitschHub showing a hero section, a banner image, and three navigation cards linking to the Games, Movies, and Music sections.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Japanese drama series from a local data source, with text search and genre filter controls rendering results in a ShowCard grid.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Korean drama series from a local data source, with text search and genre filter controls rendering results in a ShowCard grid.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Movies browsing page that filters a local movie dataset by title search, genre, and decade, displaying results in a MovieCard grid with a decorative header banner.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Music page listing public-domain audio tracks (Jazz, Classical, Ragtime, etc.) sourced from archive.org, with search and genre filtering rendered via TrackCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: React page that lets users customize the app's background wallpaper by selecting from a predefined list of textures and adjusting overlay opacity, with settings persisted via the usePersonalization hook.
frontend/src/services/aiService.ts: Service that sends chat messages to the Mistral-7B model on Hugging Face Inference API, with a keyword-based fallback response function for when the API call fails.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based semantic colors, Bebas Neue/Inter fonts, zero border-radius, and silver glow box shadows.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state, existing completed features (wallpaper list pruning and default wallpaper set to Cheetah B&W), and architectural notes for the entertainment hub app.
